text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no command-execution tool in this session, so I checked each fix by reading the code against the tests. Please run the suite to confirm.

- **`search.py`:** the import pointed at `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the policy and tests say 5.
- **`fees.py`:** the fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing the `Emma` book. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an `int`.

I didn't touch the tests.
